observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached, placed on a wooden surface. The camera body has 'Nikon' branding visible. A red box labeled '6.35 mm' is in the background.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of the camera's top right, with the 'Nikon' logo visible on the front. The camera appears to be mounted on a grip or handle.
Photo 2 shows a close-up of the camera's top left, with 'D610' clearly visible on the body. The 'FX' logo is also visible below it. The camera has a textured grip and various buttons and dials.
All photos have a watermark 'CDICSON BUSINESS WORLD'.

claims.claim: The Nikon D610 is a full-frame DSLR camera known for its 24.3-megapixel FX-format...
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows 'D610' and 'FX' logo, confirming it is a full-frame camera. The 24.3-megapixel claim is standard for this model and not visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may be non-functional or have internal damage (e.g., sensor, shutter, battery, or power issues).
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying the image on a screen.

risks.risk: Lens may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., scratches, fungus, internal issues).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens glass, especially the front and rear elements, and a video showing the lens focusing and aperture changing.

risks.risk: Camera may have been tampered with or have a non-original battery or charger.
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger, showing they are genuine Nikon accessories.
risks.if_unproven: priced as battery and charger not included

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Close-up photos of the lens glass (front and rear).
Photo of the battery and charger.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
